name: Agentic AI
certifications: No single vendor certification; assessed by capstone project
AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer - Associate (MLA-C01)

beginner.summary: For Python developers new to AI agents. Covers what agents are, how LLMs call tools, the agent loop, memory, planning, retrieval for agents, a first look at LangGraph, CrewAI and MCP, and safe limits, ending with a working single-agent assistant.
prerequisites: Writes basic Python: functions, classes, packages and virtual environments
Access to an LLM API key or a local Ollama install
outcomes: Explain how agents differ from chatbots and fixed workflows
Build agents that use tools, memory and retrieval
Build a first graph-based agent with LangGraph
Add step limits, logging and approval for risky actions

days.topic: Agentic AI Overview and Environment Setup
subtopics: What makes software agentic: goals, tools, loops
Hosted and local models for agents
Setting up Python, uv and a virtual environment
days.lab_task: Set up the course environment, call a hosted and a local model from Python, and classify ten provided business tasks as best suited to a chatbot, a fixed workflow or an agent with reasons.
days.deliverable: Working environment, two model calls and the classification table
checks: Run the hosted and local model calls
Run the script without an API key
At least eight match the answer key with reasons
objectives: Set up an agent development environment
Choose agents only where they fit

days.topic: LLM Calls for Agents: Messages, Roles and Structured Replies
subtopics: System, user, assistant and tool messages
Model parameters that matter for agents
Token usage and cost per step
Choosing a model for agent work
days.lab_task: Write a helper that calls a model, validates its reply against a Pydantic schema, retries on invalid output and logs tokens and cost for each call.
days.deliverable: Helper module, tests and a cost log
checks: Make the model return invalid JSON in a test
Helper retries and then raises a clear error
Every reply validates against the schema
Tokens and cost per call recorded
objectives: Call models reliably from agent code

days.topic: Tool Calling: Letting Models Use Functions
subtopics: How the model selects a tool
days.lab_task: Give a model weather, currency and calendar tools, execute its tool calls, return results and handle a failing tool, then improve the tool descriptions until it picks the right tool in 18 of 20 test questions.
days.deliverable: Tool definitions, execution code and tool-choice test results
checks: Ask a question that needs two tools
Both tools are called and both results are used
Model is told about the failure and does not invent data
At least 18 choose the right tool

days.topic: The Agent Loop: Reason, Act, Observe
subtopics: Writing an agent loop by hand
days.lab_task: Write an agent loop from scratch that researches a question with a search tool and a calculator, stops at a final answer or after eight steps and writes a readable step log.
days.deliverable: Agent loop code and step logs for five questions
checks: Ask a question that needs search then calculation
Agent searches, calculates and answers correctly
Agent stops at the step limit with a clear message
Feed a tool result that repeats forever

days.topic: Prompting Agents: Instructions, Personas and Policies
subtopics: Tool use rules in the prompt
Prompt changes and their side effects
days.lab_task: Write the system prompt for an IT helpdesk agent with tool rules and a password-reset policy, then test it against 15 scenarios including unclear and policy-breaking requests.
days.deliverable: System prompt and scenario test results
checks: Ask the agent to reset another person's password
Agent refuses and explains the policy

days.topic: Agent Memory: Conversation, Summaries and Long-Term Facts
days.lab_task: Add short-term and long-term memory to the helpdesk agent so it remembers a user's laptop model across sessions, summarises long chats and deletes memories on request.
days.deliverable: Memory module, tests and demo
checks: Start a new session after giving the laptop model
Ask the agent to forget the user's details
Memories are deleted and not used again
Old messages are summarised and the agent still answers correctly

days.topic: Retrieval for Agents: Searching Documents as a Tool
subtopics: Agents that decide when to search
days.lab_task: Give the helpdesk agent a search tool over IT policy documents, let it decide when to search, cite sources and combine search results with a ticket-creation tool.
days.deliverable: Search tool, agent code and 15-question test results
checks: Agent searches and cites the right document
Ask a question the documents do not answer
Agent says it cannot find it
Ask to raise a ticket about a policy issue
Agent searches, then creates a ticket with the policy reference
objectives: Use retrieval as an agent tool

days.topic: Planning and Task Decomposition
subtopics: When planning helps and when it wastes tokens
Plan formats the code can check
days.lab_task: Build a plan-and-execute agent that turns "prepare onboarding for a new hire" into steps, runs them with tools, re-plans when one tool fails and compares cost and success with the plain loop.
days.deliverable: Planner agent code and comparison results
checks: Agent re-plans and completes the goal another way
Compare with the plain loop on ten goals
Success rate and cost recorded for both
Plan is valid against the plan schema
objectives: Judge when planning is worth it

days.topic: LangGraph Essentials: States, Nodes and Edges
days.lab_task: Rebuild the helpdesk agent as a LangGraph graph with a router node, a search node, a tool node and a response node, and show the graph and a streamed run.
days.deliverable: Graph code, diagram and run trace
checks: Run a password question and a hardware question
Router sends each to the right path
Each node's output appears as it finishes

days.topic: Checkpoints, Persistence and Human Approval in LangGraph
subtopics: Approving, editing or rejecting a step
Persisting state in SQLite or Postgres
days.lab_task: Add persistence to the helpdesk graph, require human approval before any account change, let the approver edit the action and resume after a restart.
days.deliverable: Graph code, approval demo and audit records
checks: Restart the process during the pause
Edited action is executed and recorded

days.topic: Multi-Agent Systems: Roles and Hand-Offs
subtopics: When one agent is not enough
days.lab_task: Build a supervisor with research, writing and review agents that produces a one-page market brief, then compare quality and cost with a single agent on five topics.
days.deliverable: Multi-agent code, five briefs and a comparison
checks: Run the five topics with both designs
Quality scores and cost recorded for both
Supervisor passes the right context to the writer
Make the reviewer reject a draft
Writer revises and the run still finishes within the step limit

days.topic: Role-Based Agent Teams with CrewAI
days.lab_task: Build the market brief as a CrewAI crew with researcher, analyst and writer roles in a sequential and a hierarchical process, and compare the results with the LangGraph version.
days.deliverable: Crew configuration, outputs and comparison notes
checks: Brief is produced with each task's output recorded
Manager assigns tasks and the brief is produced
Differences in control, cost and quality listed

days.topic: Connecting Agents to Tools with the Model Context Protocol
days.lab_task: Write an MCP server that exposes the ticket system, connect it to the helpdesk agent and to an IDE assistant, and require approval for the create-ticket tool.
days.deliverable: MCP server, agent integration and demo
checks: Ticket tools appear from the MCP server
Create a ticket through the agent
Approval is requested before the call
Agent reports the tool is unavailable

days.topic: Agents That Work with Code and Data
subtopics: Running generated code in a sandbox
Checking generated SQL before running it
days.lab_task: Build a data analyst agent that writes and runs Python in a Docker sandbox and SQL against a read-only database, answers ten business questions and refuses to run destructive SQL.
days.deliverable: Agent code, sandbox setup and answers to the ten questions
checks: Ask a question that needs a chart
Chart is produced from sandboxed code
Ask the agent to delete a table
Refused, and the read-only user would block it anyway
Compare the ten answers with the answer key

days.topic: Browser and Web Agents
subtopics: When to use an API instead
days.lab_task: Build an agent that researches three competitors' public pricing pages with Playwright, extracts prices into a table and ignores a hidden instruction planted on one test page.
days.deliverable: Agent code, price table and injection test result
checks: Run on the three test pages
Visit the page with a hidden instruction
Hit the site rate limit setting
Agent waits instead of retrying rapidly

days.topic: Agent Safety: Permissions, Limits and Guardrails
days.lab_task: Add budgets, approval rules, an allow list of tools per user role and an output filter to the helpdesk agent, then run ten attack scenarios and record which are stopped.
days.deliverable: Safety configuration and attack test results
checks: Run the agent past its cost budget
It stops and reports the budget
Use a role without access to a tool
Tool is not offered or called

days.topic: Testing and Evaluating Agents
subtopics: Why agents are hard to test
Success rate, steps and cost metrics
days.lab_task: Write unit tests for every helpdesk tool, 20 scenario tests that check the tool calls and final answers, and a report of success rate, average steps and cost.
days.deliverable: Test suite and evaluation report
checks: Success rate, steps and cost per scenario

days.topic: Observability for Agents: Tracing Steps and Costs
subtopics: Tracing each step and tool call
Token and cost tracking per run
Keeping personal data out of traces
days.lab_task: Trace every helpdesk run in Langfuse, build a dashboard of success, cost and latency, and use traces to find and fix the two most common failure patterns.
days.deliverable: Tracing setup, dashboard and two fixes with evidence
checks: Every step, tool call, token count and latency is visible
Rerun the failing scenarios after the fix

days.topic: Deploying an Agent as a Service
subtopics: Streaming agent steps to a UI
days.lab_task: Deploy the helpdesk agent as a FastAPI service in Docker with per-user threads, streamed steps to a Streamlit UI, background runs and rate limits.
days.deliverable: Service, Docker image and UI demo
checks: Each sees only their own conversation
Runs in the background and the user can check status

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: IT Helpdesk Agent
subtopics: Agent graph with memory and retrieval
days.lab_task: Deliver an IT helpdesk agent that answers from policies with citations, raises and updates tickets through MCP tools, asks approval for account changes, has budgets and guardrails, passes 20 scenario tests and runs as a service, then demo it.
days.deliverable: Repository, test report, traces and a 10-minute demo
checks: Try a prompt injection through a policy document
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one agent

intermediate.summary: For developers who have built a simple agent. Covers production agent design with LangGraph, multi-agent patterns, agent protocols, enterprise tool integration, retrieval-heavy agents, evaluation, guardrails, observability, cost control and deployment on cloud agent platforms.
prerequisites: Has built a tool-using agent in Python
Knows LangGraph or a similar framework at a basic level
Comfortable with REST APIs, Docker and Git
outcomes: Design agent workflows that are reliable and observable
Build multi-agent systems with clear hand-offs and protocols
Evaluate, secure and control the cost of agents
Deploy agents on cloud agent platforms

days.topic: Agent Design Patterns: Routers, Workflows and Autonomous Loops
subtopics: Choosing the least autonomy that works
days.lab_task: Implement the same expense-claim process as a chain, a router, an orchestrator-worker graph and an autonomous agent, and compare success, cost and predictability on 20 claims.
days.deliverable: Four implementations and a comparison table
checks: Run the 20 claims on all four
Success and cost recorded for each
Run each design five times on one claim
objectives: Choose the simplest design that works

days.topic: Advanced LangGraph: Subgraphs, Parallel Branches and Reducers
days.lab_task: Build a contract review graph that splits a contract into clauses, reviews them in parallel subgraphs, merges findings with a reducer and retries failed clause reviews.
days.deliverable: Graph code, tests and run traces
checks: All clauses reviewed in parallel and merged
Make two clause reviews fail once
They are retried and the run completes
Unit test passes without the parent graph

days.topic: Agent State, Memory and Context Engineering
subtopics: Deciding what goes into the context
Context poisoning and how to avoid it
days.lab_task: Add long-term semantic and episodic memory to the contract agent so it reuses past decisions on similar clauses, keeping the context under a set token budget and measuring the effect.
days.deliverable: Memory design, code and before and after measurements
checks: Review a clause similar to a past one
Past decision is retrieved and cited
Agent flags the conflict instead of trusting it

days.topic: Multi-Agent Architectures: Supervisor, Swarm and Hierarchical Teams
days.lab_task: Build a customer onboarding system as a supervisor design and as a swarm design with KYC, account set-up and welcome agents, then compare reliability, cost and debugging effort.
days.deliverable: Two implementations, traces and comparison
checks: Make the KYC agent fail a check
Case stops with a clear reason in both designs
Termination rules keep messages under the limit

days.topic: Agent Protocols: MCP and Agent-to-Agent Communication
subtopics: Calling an agent built with another framework
days.lab_task: Expose the KYC agent over A2A, call it from a LangGraph supervisor and a CrewAI crew, and connect both to a remote MCP server secured with OAuth.
days.deliverable: A2A service, MCP server and integration demo
checks: Call the KYC agent from both frameworks
Call the MCP server without a token

days.topic: Enterprise Tool Integration: APIs, Databases and SaaS Systems
tools: Microsoft Graph or Google Workspace APIs
days.lab_task: Give the onboarding agent tools for the HR API, the user's calendar through OAuth and a CRM, make write tools idempotent and publish them in a team tool catalogue.
days.deliverable: Tool library, catalogue entries and integration tests
checks: Call the create-account tool twice with the same request ID
Schedule a meeting for a user
Created in that user's calendar with their consent

days.topic: Agentic RAG: Agents That Plan Their Retrieval
subtopics: Corrective retrieval when evidence is weak
days.lab_task: Build an agent that answers policy and data questions by choosing between a policy index, a product index and a SQL database, re-searching when evidence is weak and citing every source.
days.deliverable: Agent code and evaluation on 40 questions
checks: Ask a question needing two sources
Give a question with weak first results
Agent rewrites the query and searches again

days.topic: Human-in-the-Loop Workflows and Approvals
subtopics: Where people must stay in the loop
Approval interfaces in Slack or Teams
days.lab_task: Send approval requests from the expense agent to Slack or Teams with approve, edit and reject buttons, escalate after a timeout, and record every decision.
days.deliverable: Approval integration, audit trail and demo
checks: Submit a claim over the limit
Approval request appears in the chat tool
Reject a claim with a reason
Agent informs the employee and records the reason

days.topic: Evaluating Agents: Trajectories, Outcomes and Costs
subtopics: Cost and latency budgets as tests
days.lab_task: Build an evaluation suite for the onboarding system with simulated users, trajectory checks and outcome judges, and add it to CI with thresholds for success, cost and latency.
days.deliverable: Evaluation suite, CI workflow and reports
checks: Open a pull request that adds an unnecessary tool call
Success rate and cost per case reported

days.topic: Guardrails, Policies and Safe Autonomy
days.lab_task: Move the expense agent's spending rules into Open Policy Agent, add data guardrails and injection defences, and test them with 30 normal and 15 attack scenarios.
days.deliverable: Policy files, guardrail configuration and test results
checks: Approve a claim outside policy through the agent

days.topic: Observability, Debugging and Replay of Agent Runs
subtopics: OpenTelemetry semantic conventions for generative AI
days.lab_task: Instrument the onboarding system with OpenTelemetry, replay three failed runs from their traces after fixes, and set alerts on failure rate and cost per run.
days.deliverable: Instrumentation, replay results and alert rules
checks: Replay a failed run after the fix
Run now succeeds with the same inputs
Raise the failure rate in a test
Search traces for an email address

days.topic: Cost and Latency Engineering for Agents
subtopics: Cost per task, not per call
days.lab_task: Reduce the contract agent's cost per contract by at least 40 percent and its time by 30 percent with routing, caching and parallel steps, keeping its evaluation score within two points.
days.deliverable: Optimisation report with cost, latency and quality before and after

days.topic: Event-Driven Agents: Triggers, Schedules and Webhooks
subtopics: Agents that start without a chat message
days.lab_task: Trigger the invoice agent from a webhook when a new invoice arrives and from a nightly schedule for overdue ones, deduplicate repeated events and send failed runs to a dead-letter queue.
days.deliverable: Trigger services, queue configuration and run logs
checks: Every overdue invoice gets one reminder
Make one run fail three times
Moved to the dead-letter queue with the error
objectives: Run agents from events and schedules

days.topic: Multi-Agent Collaboration with AutoGen and Semantic Kernel
subtopics: Planners and function calling in Semantic Kernel
Choosing between AutoGen, Semantic Kernel and LangGraph
days.lab_task: Build the market brief team in AutoGen with a group chat and in Semantic Kernel with plugins, apply the same step limits and compare both with the LangGraph version.
days.deliverable: Two implementations and a framework comparison
checks: Brief produced and the chat stops at the termination rule
Plugins are called and the brief is produced
Control, cost and code size compared with numbers
objectives: Build agents with AutoGen and Semantic Kernel
Choose a framework for the team

days.topic: Building Agents with the OpenAI Agents SDK
subtopics: Agents, tools and hand-offs in the SDK
Running agents with other model providers
days.lab_task: Rebuild the onboarding hand-off flow with the OpenAI Agents SDK, add input guardrails, view its traces and compare code, control and portability with the LangGraph version.
days.deliverable: SDK implementation and comparison notes
checks: Same or better success than LangGraph version, or the gap explained
Run stops before the agent acts
Runs with configuration changes only, or the limit is documented
objectives: Build agents with the OpenAI Agents SDK

days.topic: Cloud Agent Platforms: Azure AI Foundry, Amazon Bedrock Agents and Vertex AI Agent Builder
subtopics: Defining agents and tools on each platform
days.lab_task: Build the same policy-answering agent with a ticket tool on two cloud agent platforms, compare set-up effort, quality, monitoring and cost, and recommend one for the company.
days.deliverable: Two platform implementations and a recommendation
checks: Ask the same ten questions on both
Call the ticket tool from both

days.topic: Deploying Agents at Scale with Durable Execution
days.lab_task: Run the contract agent as a durable workflow that survives worker crashes, scale workers to process 500 contracts and release a new agent version with blue-green deployment.
days.deliverable: Deployment files, scaling results and release record
checks: Work resumes on another worker without repeating side effects

days.topic: Security for Agentic Systems
subtopics: OWASP Top 10 for LLM and agentic applications
Identity for agents: service accounts and delegated access
Supply chain risks in tools and MCP servers
days.lab_task: Threat-model the onboarding system, give each agent its own identity with least privilege, move tool secrets to Vault and run a security test for data exfiltration through tools.
days.deliverable: Threat model, identity configuration and security test report
checks: Use the welcome agent's identity to call the KYC tool
Search the code and images for secrets
Attempt exfiltration through the email tool

days.topic: Agent Product Design and User Experience
subtopics: Showing progress and plans to users
days.lab_task: Redesign the helpdesk agent's interface to show the plan, live progress, sources and an undo button, then run a usability test with five users and measure task success.
days.deliverable: Updated interface and usability test results
checks: Every claim links to a source

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Multi-Agent Business Process Automation
days.lab_task: Automate a real business process such as employee onboarding or invoice handling with cooperating agents, enterprise tools through MCP, human approvals, policy guardrails, CI evaluation, tracing and durable deployment, then present it.
days.deliverable: Repository, evaluation report, dashboards, deployment and a 15-minute demo
checks: Meets the agreed success, cost and latency thresholds
Kill a worker during a process
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one system

advanced.summary: For engineers and architects running agents in production. Covers agent architecture at enterprise scale, reasoning models, learning agents, computer-use and coding agents, formal safety, security, governance, multi-agent platforms, evaluation research and the economics of agentic systems.
prerequisites: Has built and deployed a multi-agent system
Uses evaluation, tracing and guardrails in practice
Comfortable with cloud platforms and distributed systems
outcomes: Architect agent platforms for many teams
Use reasoning models, learning and computer-use agents well
Govern, secure and evaluate autonomous systems at scale
Make sound build, buy and cost decisions for agentic AI

days.topic: Enterprise Agent Platform Architecture
subtopics: Shared tool and MCP server catalogue
days.lab_task: Design and build a minimal agent platform with a registry, a governed tool catalogue, a policy service and shared tracing, then onboard two agents from different teams onto it.
days.deliverable: Platform architecture, running services and onboarding record
checks: It appears in the registry with owner and capabilities
Have one team's agent call another team's private tool
Each team sees only its own

days.topic: Reasoning Models and Test-Time Compute
days.lab_task: Compare a reasoning model and a standard model as the planner in the contract agent on 30 hard cases at three reasoning budgets, and design a router that uses reasoning only when needed.
days.deliverable: Comparison results and router design with measurements
checks: Accuracy close to the best setting at lower cost
Verify a reasoning output with a checker step

days.topic: Learning Agents: Feedback, Self-Improvement and Fine-Tuning
subtopics: Reinforcement learning for tool use in brief
days.lab_task: Optimise the helpdesk agent's prompts with DSPy from logged feedback, fine-tune a small model on successful trajectories and accept changes only when the evaluation suite improves.
days.deliverable: Optimisation runs, fine-tuned model and acceptance record
checks: Swap in the fine-tuned model for simple steps
Change is rejected by the evaluation gate

days.topic: Computer-Use and Desktop Automation Agents
days.lab_task: Automate a legacy desktop data-entry task with a computer-use agent in a sandboxed virtual desktop, add human take-over and compare reliability with an RPA script.
days.deliverable: Agent setup, run recordings and reliability comparison
checks: Agent adapts where the RPA script fails, or limits are recorded
Agent pauses and hands control over

days.topic: Coding Agents and Software Engineering Automation
subtopics: Coding agents in the IDE and CI
Risks: insecure code and licence issues
tools: GitHub Copilot coding agent or similar
days.lab_task: Set up a coding agent that takes labelled issues, writes code and tests in a branch, opens a pull request and must pass tests and a Semgrep scan, then measure results on ten issues.
days.deliverable: Agent configuration, ten pull requests and a results report
checks: Merged, revised and rejected counts recorded
Cannot push to the main branch

days.topic: Formal Safety: Verification, Constraints and Safe Action Spaces
days.lab_task: Add pre- and post-conditions to every finance tool, run the agent in shadow mode against a week of real requests and show that unsafe actions are blocked before execution.
days.deliverable: Tool contracts, shadow-mode report and blocked-action log
checks: Agent decisions are recorded without side effects
Submit an action that breaks a post-condition

days.topic: Advanced Agent Security and Adversarial Testing
subtopics: Tool poisoning and malicious MCP servers
days.lab_task: Red-team the intermediate capstone system with cross-agent injection, a malicious MCP server and memory poisoning, fix the findings and add attack detection to monitoring.
days.deliverable: Red-team report, fixes and detection rules
checks: It is blocked by the tool allow list
Poisoned entry is detected or ignored
Run the attacks again after fixes

days.topic: Governance, Accountability and Regulation for Autonomous Systems
subtopics: EU AI Act and agentic systems
days.lab_task: Build an agent inventory with risk tiers for five company agents, define delegated authority limits and records for the highest-risk one and prepare a board risk report.
days.deliverable: Agent inventory, authority matrix and board report
checks: Every action has a limit and an accountable person

days.topic: Evaluation Research for Agents: Benchmarks and Simulation Environments
subtopics: Public agent benchmarks and their limits
days.lab_task: Build a simulation environment for the onboarding process with synthetic users and adversaries, run three agent versions 30 times each and report success with confidence intervals and cost.
days.deliverable: Simulation environment, results and benchmark report
checks: Success rates with confidence intervals reported
Check the benchmark for leaked training examples

days.topic: Agent Interoperability Across Vendors and Clouds
subtopics: Protocols: MCP, A2A and OpenAPI tools
tools: Azure AI Foundry or Amazon Bedrock Agents
days.lab_task: Run one workflow where a LangGraph agent on Kubernetes calls a managed cloud agent over A2A and shared MCP tools, with federated identity and contract tests on each interface.
days.deliverable: Cross-platform workflow, identity set-up and contract tests
checks: Change a field in an agent's interface
Run the workflow end to end
Call across platforms without a valid token

days.topic: Large-Scale Multi-Agent Orchestration
days.lab_task: Run 200 concurrent research tasks across a pool of specialised agents with priorities, back-pressure and failure isolation, and keep cost and latency within budgets under load.
days.deliverable: Orchestration design, load test results and dashboards
checks: All complete within the time budget
Other agents keep working and failed tasks retry

days.topic: Knowledge Graphs and Structured Reasoning for Agents
days.lab_task: Build a supplier risk graph from contracts and news, give the agent graph query and vector search tools, and answer 20 multi-hop risk questions with graph-path explanations.
days.deliverable: Graph, agent code and evaluation results
checks: Accuracy recorded with graph and without
Show the path behind one answer
Graph updates and the agent uses it

days.topic: Voice and Real-Time Agents
days.lab_task: Build a voice agent for appointment booking that calls calendar tools during the conversation, handles interruptions, keeps response time under one second and records consent.
days.deliverable: Voice agent, latency report and call recordings
checks: It stops and responds to the new input

days.topic: Privacy and Data Governance for Agent Memory and Retrieval
subtopics: Personal data in memory, traces and indexes
days.lab_task: Map every place the onboarding system stores personal data, enforce document-level access in retrieval, apply retention rules and carry out an erasure request across memory, traces and indexes.
days.deliverable: Data map, access rules, retention configuration and erasure record
checks: Ask the agent for a document the user may not see
Run an erasure request for one person
No data remains in memory, traces or indexes
Check stores after the retention period

days.topic: Agents in Regulated Industries: Banking, Healthcare and Insurance
subtopics: Case studies of approved and failed deployments
days.lab_task: Prepare a model risk file for a loan-document agent covering design, testing, fairness checks, explanations and controls, and test that every decision can be reconstructed from records.
days.deliverable: Model risk file, fairness test results and decision reconstruction demo
checks: Inputs, steps, sources and approver are all shown
Run fairness tests on two groups
No decision completes with one approver

days.topic: Economics and Operating Model of Agentic AI
subtopics: Cost per task and value per task
Build, buy or use a platform
Staffing: agent engineers, evaluators and owners
Stopping projects that do not work
days.lab_task: Build a value and cost model for three agent projects from real trace data, rank them, recommend which to scale and which to stop, and present it to leadership.
days.deliverable: Cost and value model and a five-slide recommendation
checks: Compute cost per task from traces
Ranking follows from value and cost
Scale and stop decisions are justified

days.topic: Production Incident Response for Agents
subtopics: Model or provider changes that break agents
days.lab_task: Handle three injected incidents (a runaway loop, an agent sending wrong emails and a provider model change), stop the damage, compensate the wrong actions, find root causes and write runbooks.
days.deliverable: Incident timelines, compensating actions and runbooks
checks: All affected agents stop within a minute
Corrections sent to every affected person
Write a runbook for model changes

days.topic: Agentic AI Strategy and Architecture Reviews
days.lab_task: Review two proposed agent designs from a case study, assess risk and readiness, write decision records and defend a recommendation to a mock architecture board.
days.deliverable: Review notes, decision records and presentation
checks: List the risks in each design

days.topic: Edge Cases: Long-Horizon Tasks, Recovery and Goal Drift
subtopics: Goal drift and how to detect it
Stopping and handing back to people
days.lab_task: Run a multi-day vendor onboarding task with simulated delays and failures, detect and correct goal drift, recover from two partial failures and report progress daily.
days.deliverable: Long-running workflow, drift detection and progress reports
checks: Inject a partial failure on day two
Workflow recovers without repeating completed steps
Drift detector flags it and the agent re-anchors

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Governed Enterprise Agent Platform
days.lab_task: Deliver an agent platform that hosts agents from two teams and one vendor with a registry, governed tools, formal action constraints, red-team results, learning with evaluation gates, load tests and a cost model, then present it to a mock board.
days.deliverable: Platform repository, security and evaluation reports, cost model and a 20-minute presentation
checks: Trigger the kill switch during load
All agents stop safely and work resumes cleanly
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one platform
